title: Signature study: RSA as predecessor and successor to Zero-knowledge proofs
description: 1977 — RSA: RSA is a public-key cryptosystem whose security rests on the difficulty of factoring large integers. as predecessor and successor to Zero-knowledge proofs (1985), This Signature lineage study traces how the later design answers the earlier one's weaknesses. Zero-knowledge proofs let one party prove a statement true without revealing anything beyond the statement itself. Filed as JAH-CRY-000007 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
